     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivSchemeWindowMulGeneral
     8	import AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.EffectiveUniqueness
     9	import AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.SumIntersection
    10	import AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.WindowLedger
    11	
    12	/-!
    13	# The two-coordinate recurrence in a field window
    14	
    15	For `F = fiberWeilDivisor pi` and `u = fiberCoordUnit pi`, the two sections
    16	`1` and `u⁻¹` of `O(F)` generate every sufficiently large window:
    17	
    18	`H⁰(O((m + 1)F)) = H⁰(O(mF)) + u⁻¹ H⁰(O(mF))`.
    19	
    20	The proof is the divisor-section form of the standard two-chart argument.  The
    21	two shifted divisors are `mF` and `mF - div(u⁻¹)`; their supremum is
    22	`(m + 1)F`, while the degree of their infimum is `(m - 1) deg(F)`.  Thus the
    23	four `H¹` hypotheses needed by `divisorSections_sup` are discharged by the
    24	window ledger as soon as `windowS ≤ m`.
    25	
    26	The final pair theorem records the same recurrence through the existing field
    27	theta presentation `thetaSectionPair`.  It is intentionally stated over a
    28	field curve; residue-field specialisations can instantiate it without any
    29	relative nilpotent-base assertion.
    30	-/
    31	
    32	set_option autoImplicit false
    33	set_option quotPrecheck false
    34	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    35	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 4
    36	set_option maxRecDepth 6000
    37	set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
    38	
    39	universe u
    40	
    41	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite
    42	
    43	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    44	
    45	open Scheme
    46	
    47	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    48	  Scheme.functionFieldOverModule
    49	
    50	section CoordinateRecurrence
    51	
    52	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    53	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi] [IsDominant pi]
    54	
    55	noncomputable local instance instOverCleftThetaCoordinateRecurrence :
    56	    C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩
    57	
    58	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsIntegral C.left]
    59	  [LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    60	  [QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    61	variable [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0)]
    62	  [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1)]
    63	variable (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    64	
    65	local notation "F" => fiberWeilDivisor pi
    66	local notation "u" => fiberCoordUnit pi
    67	local notation "H" n => ↥(divisorSections k (n • F) ⊤)
    68	
    69	/-! ## Small coefficient helpers -/
    70	
    71	private lemma coeffAt_nsmul (n : Nat) (D : C.left.CurveDivisor) {x : C.left}
    72	    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint C.left) :
    73	    coeffAt hx (n • D) = (n : Int) * coeffAt hx D := by
    74	  induction n with
    75	  | zero => simp
    76	  | succ n ih =>
    77	      rw [succ_nsmul, CurveDivisor.coeffAt_add, ih, Nat.cast_succ]
    78	      ring
    79	
    80	private lemma coeffAt_divOf_inv (v : C.left.functionFieldˣ) {x : C.left}
    81	    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint C.left) :
    82	    coeffAt hx (Scheme.divOf (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) v⁻¹) =
    83	      -coeffAt hx (Scheme.divOf (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) v) := by
    84	  have h : Scheme.divOf (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) v⁻¹ +
    85	      Scheme.divOf (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) v = 0 := by
    86	    rw [← Scheme.divOf_mul, inv_mul_cancel, Scheme.divOf_one]
    87	  have hc := congrArg (coeffAt hx) h
    88	  rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_add, CurveDivisor.coeffAt_zero] at hc
    89	  linarith
    90	
    91	/-! ## The two canonical field-window generators -/
    92	
    93	/-- The field-window representative of `(t₀, 1)`. -/
    94	noncomputable def thetaCoordinateFstOne
    95	    (_hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) : H 1 :=
    96	  ⟨1, by
    97	    simpa only [one_smul] using
    98	      (one_mem_divisorSections_top k (fiberWeilDivisor_nonneg pi))⟩
    99	
   100	private theorem fiberCoordUnit_inv_mem_divisorSections :
   101	    (((u⁻¹ : C.left.functionFieldˣ) : C.left.functionField)) ∈
   102	      divisorSections k (1 • F) ⊤ := by
   103	  let v : C.left.functionFieldˣ := u⁻¹
   104	  change (v : C.left.functionField) ∈ divisorSections k (1 • F) ⊤
   105	  rw [mem_divisorSections_top_iff k (Units.ne_zero v)]
   106	  refine CurveDivisor.le_iff_coeffAt.mpr (fun x hx => ?_)
   107	  have hmk : Units.mk0 (v : C.left.functionField) (Units.ne_zero v) = v :=
   108	    Units.ext rfl
   109	  rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_zero, hmk, CurveDivisor.coeffAt_add, coeffAt_nsmul,
   110	    fiberWeilDivisor_coeffAt pi, coeffAt_divOf_inv]
   111	  have hleft : coeffAt hx
   112	      (Scheme.divOf (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) u) ≤
   113	      max (coeffAt hx (Scheme.divOf
   114	        (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) u)) 0 := le_max_left _ _
   115	  norm_num
   116	
   117	/-- The field-window representative of `(1, t₁)`: the inverse of the fibre unit. -/
   118	noncomputable def thetaCoordinateSndOne
   119	    (_hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) : H 1 :=
   120	  ⟨((u⁻¹ : C.left.functionFieldˣ) : C.left.functionField),
   121	    fiberCoordUnit_inv_mem_divisorSections (C := C) pi⟩
   122	
   123	@[simp]
   124	theorem thetaCoordinateFstOne_coe :
   125	    ((thetaCoordinateFstOne (C := C) pi hpi : H 1) : C.left.functionField) = 1 := rfl
   126	
   127	@[simp]
   128	theorem thetaCoordinateSndOne_coe :
   129	    ((thetaCoordinateSndOne (C := C) pi hpi : H 1) : C.left.functionField) =
   130	      ((u⁻¹ : C.left.functionFieldˣ) : C.left.functionField) := rfl
   131	
   132	noncomputable def thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (m : Nat) : C.left.CurveDivisor :=
   133	  m • F - Scheme.divOf (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (u⁻¹)
   134	
   135	/-! ## Divisor arithmetic behind the recurrence -/
   136	
   137	set_option maxHeartbeats 800000 in
   138	-- The coefficientwise max/subtraction normalization is nonlinear in the order value.
   139	theorem thetaCoordinate_sup (m : Nat) :
   140	    (m • F) ⊔ thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (C := C) pi m = (1 + m) • F := by
   141	  refine CurveDivisor.ext_coeffAt (fun x hx => ?_)
   142	  rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_sup, thetaCoordinateSndDivisor,
   143	    CurveDivisor.coeffAt_sub]
   144	  simp only [coeffAt_nsmul, fiberWeilDivisor_coeffAt, coeffAt_divOf_inv]
   145	  by_cases hd : coeffAt hx (Scheme.divOf (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) u) ≤ 0
   146	  · have hmax : max (coeffAt hx (Scheme.divOf
   147	        (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) u)) 0 = 0 := max_eq_right hd
   148	    simp only [hmax]
   149	    have hcomp : (m : Int) * 0 - -coeffAt hx
   150	        (Scheme.divOf (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) u) ≤ (m : Int) * 0 := by
   151	      simpa using hd
   152	    rw [max_eq_left hcomp]
   153	    norm_num
   154	  · have hd' : 0 ≤ coeffAt hx
   155	        (Scheme.divOf (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) u) :=
   156	      le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hd)
   157	    have hmax : max (coeffAt hx (Scheme.divOf
   158	        (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) u)) 0 =
   159	        coeffAt hx (Scheme.divOf (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) u) :=
   160	      max_eq_left hd'
   161	    simp only [hmax]
   162	    have hcomp : (m : Int) * coeffAt hx
   163	          (Scheme.divOf (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) u) ≤
   164	        (m : Int) * coeffAt hx
   165	          (Scheme.divOf (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) u) - -
   166	          coeffAt hx (Scheme.divOf (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) u) := by
   167	      nlinarith [Int.natCast_nonneg m, hd']
   168	    rw [max_eq_right hcomp]
   169	    push_cast
   170	    ring
   171	
   172	theorem thetaCoordinateSndDivisor_deg (m : Nat) :
   173	    CurveDivisor.deg k (thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (C := C) pi m) =
   174	      (m : Int) * windowδ pi := by
   175	  rw [thetaCoordinateSndDivisor, Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_sub' k,
   176	    Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_nsmul' k, deg_fiberWeilDivisor_windowδ,
   177	    deg_divOf k, sub_zero]
   178	
   179	private theorem thetaCoordinate_window_h1 (g m : Nat) (hm : windowS_choice pi hpi g ≤ m) :
   180	    (Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.divisorSheaf k (m • F)) 1) ∧
   181	      Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
   182	        (C.left.divisorSheaf k (thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (C := C) pi m)) 1) ∧
   183	      Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
   184	        (C.left.divisorSheaf k ((m • F) ⊓
   185	          thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (C := C) pi m)) 1) ∧
   186	      Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
   187	        (C.left.divisorSheaf k ((m • F) ⊔
   188	          thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (C := C) pi m)) 1)) := by
   189	  have hδ : 0 ≤ windowδ pi := windowδ_nonneg pi
   190	  have hS : windowBound pi hpi + 2 * (g : Int) ≤
   191	      ((windowS_choice pi hpi g : Int) - 1) * windowδ pi :=
   192	    windowS_spec pi hpi g
   193	  have hm' : (windowS_choice pi hpi g : Int) ≤ (m : Int) := by
   194	    exact_mod_cast hm
   195	  have hb0 : windowBound pi hpi ≤ (m : Int) * windowδ pi := by
   196	    have hs0 : (windowS_choice pi hpi g : Int) * windowδ pi ≤
   197	        (m : Int) * windowδ pi := by
   198	      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hm' hδ
   199	    have := windowBound_le_S_mul pi hpi g
   200	    linarith
   201	  have hb1 : windowBound pi hpi ≤
   202	      CurveDivisor.deg k (thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (C := C) pi m) := by
   203	    rw [thetaCoordinateSndDivisor_deg]
   204	    exact hb0
   205	  have hsupdeg : CurveDivisor.deg k ((m • F) ⊔
   206	      thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (C := C) pi m) =
   207	      ((1 + m : Nat) : Int) * windowδ pi := by
   208	    rw [thetaCoordinate_sup, Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_nsmul' k,
   209	      deg_fiberWeilDivisor_windowδ]
   210	  have hinfdeg : CurveDivisor.deg k ((m • F) ⊓
   211	      thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (C := C) pi m) =
   212	      ((m : Int) - 1) * windowδ pi := by
   213	    have hbal := Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_inf_add_deg_sup k (m • F)
   214	      (thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (C := C) pi m)
   215	    rw [Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_nsmul' k, deg_fiberWeilDivisor_windowδ,
   216	      thetaCoordinateSndDivisor_deg, hsupdeg] at hbal
   217	    push_cast at hbal ⊢
   218	    nlinarith [hbal]
   219	  have hbinf : windowBound pi hpi ≤
   220	      CurveDivisor.deg k ((m • F) ⊓
   221	        thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (C := C) pi m) := by
   222	    rw [hinfdeg]
   223	    have hm1 : ((windowS_choice pi hpi g : Int) - 1) * windowδ pi ≤
   224	        ((m : Int) - 1) * windowδ pi := by
   225	      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith [hm']) hδ
   226	    linarith
   227	  have hbsup : windowBound pi hpi ≤
   228	      CurveDivisor.deg k ((m • F) ⊔ thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (C := C) pi m) := by
   229	    rw [hsupdeg]
   230	    have hmono : (m : Int) * windowδ pi ≤
   231	        ((1 + m : Nat) : Int) * windowδ pi := by
   232	      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by omega) hδ
   233	    linarith
   234	  exact ⟨(by
   235	      apply windowBound_spec pi hpi _
   236	      rw [Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_nsmul' k, deg_fiberWeilDivisor_windowδ]
   237	      exact hb0),
   238	    windowBound_spec pi hpi _ hb1,
   239	    windowBound_spec pi hpi _ hbinf,
   240	    windowBound_spec pi hpi _ hbsup⟩
   241	
   242	/-! ## The field-window span and elementwise recurrence -/
   243	
   244	set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
   245	-- Rewriting both principal-divisor images and the dependent lattice supremum is expensive.
   246	theorem thetaCoordinate_window_span (g m : Nat)
   247	    (hm : windowS_choice pi hpi g ≤ m) :
   248	    Submodule.map (Scheme.mulLinear k (1 : C.left.functionField))
   249	        (divisorSections k (m • F) ⊤) ⊔
   250	      Submodule.map (Scheme.mulLinear k
   251	        ((u⁻¹ : C.left.functionFieldˣ) : C.left.functionField))
   252	        (divisorSections k (m • F) ⊤) =
   253	      divisorSections k ((1 + m) • F) ⊤ := by
   254	  have hwin := thetaCoordinate_window_h1 (C := C) pi hpi g m hm
   255	  have hfst := map_mulLinear_divisorSections_top k (f := (1 : C.left.functionField))
   256	    one_ne_zero (m • F)
   257	  have hsnd := map_mulLinear_divisorSections_top k
   258	    (f := ((u⁻¹ : C.left.functionFieldˣ) : C.left.functionField))
   259	    (Units.ne_zero (u⁻¹)) (m • F)
   260	  have hmk1 : Units.mk0 (1 : C.left.functionField) one_ne_zero = 1 :=
   261	    Units.ext rfl
   262	  have hmk : Units.mk0 ((u⁻¹ : C.left.functionFieldˣ) : C.left.functionField)
   263	      (Units.ne_zero (u⁻¹)) = u⁻¹ := Units.ext rfl
   264	  rw [hfst, hsnd, hmk1, Scheme.divOf_one, sub_zero, hmk]
   265	  calc
   266	    divisorSections k (m • F) ⊤ ⊔
   267	        divisorSections k (thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (C := C) pi m) ⊤ =
   268	      divisorSections k ((m • F) ⊔
   269	        thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (C := C) pi m) ⊤ :=
   270	      divisorSections_sup k (m • F)
   271	        (thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (C := C) pi m)
   272	        hwin.1 hwin.2.1 hwin.2.2.1 hwin.2.2.2
   273	    _ = divisorSections k ((1 + m) • F) ⊤ := by
   274	      rw [thetaCoordinate_sup]
   275	
   276	theorem exists_thetaCoordinate_decomposition (g m : Nat)
   277	    (hm : windowS_choice pi hpi g ≤ m) (h : H(1 + m)) :
   278	    ∃ z₀ z₁ : H m,
   279	      h = thetaWindowMul (C := C) (pi := pi) 1 m
   280	          (thetaCoordinateFstOne (C := C) pi hpi) z₀ +
   281	        thetaWindowMul (C := C) (pi := pi) 1 m
   282	          (thetaCoordinateSndOne (C := C) pi hpi) z₁ := by
   283	  have hspan := thetaCoordinate_window_span (C := C) pi hpi g m hm
   284	  have hh : (h : C.left.functionField) ∈
   285	      Submodule.map (Scheme.mulLinear k (1 : C.left.functionField))
   286	          (divisorSections k (m • F) ⊤) ⊔
   287	        Submodule.map (Scheme.mulLinear k
   288	          ((u⁻¹ : C.left.functionFieldˣ) : C.left.functionField))
   289	          (divisorSections k (m • F) ⊤) := by
   290	    rw [hspan]
   291	    exact h.property
   292	  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hab⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hh
   293	  rcases ha with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
   294	  rcases hb with ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
   295	  refine ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨b, hb⟩, ?_⟩
   296	  apply Subtype.ext
   297	  rw [Submodule.coe_add, thetaWindowMul_coe, thetaWindowMul_coe,
   298	    thetaCoordinateFstOne_coe, thetaCoordinateSndOne_coe, one_mul]
   299	  simpa only [Scheme.mulLinear_apply, one_mul] using hab.symm
   300	
   301	/-! ## The same recurrence through the field theta pair -/
   302	
   303	/-- Componentwise multiplication of field theta pairs. -/
   304	noncomputable def thetaSectionPairMul (a b : Nat)
   305	    (x : ↥(twistSubmodule k (fiberChart₀ pi) (fiberChart₁ pi)
   306	      (thetaUnit pi ^ a) ⊤))
   307	    (y : ↥(twistSubmodule k (fiberChart₀ pi) (fiberChart₁ pi)
   308	      (thetaUnit pi ^ b) ⊤)) :
   309	    ↥(twistSubmodule k (fiberChart₀ pi) (fiberChart₁ pi)
   310	      (thetaUnit pi ^ (a + b)) ⊤) := by
   311	  refine ⟨(x.1.1 * y.1.1, x.1.2 * y.1.2), ?_⟩
   312	  rw [mem_twistSubmodule_iff]
   313	  have hx := (mem_twistSubmodule_iff k (fiberChart₀ pi) (fiberChart₁ pi)
   314	    (thetaUnit pi ^ a) x.1).mp x.2
   315	  have hy := (mem_twistSubmodule_iff k (fiberChart₀ pi) (fiberChart₁ pi)
   316	    (thetaUnit pi ^ b) y.1).mp y.2
   317	  rw [map_mul, map_mul, pow_add, Units.val_mul, map_mul, hx, hy]
   318	  ring
   319	
   320	theorem thetaSectionPair_thetaWindowMul (p q : Nat)
   321	    (a : ↥(divisorSections k (p • F) ⊤))
   322	    (m : ↥(divisorSections k (q • F) ⊤)) :
   323	    thetaSectionPair C pi (p + q)
   324	        (thetaWindowMul (C := C) (pi := pi) p q a m) =
   325	      thetaSectionPairMul (C := C) pi p q
   326	        (thetaSectionPair C pi p a) (thetaSectionPair C pi q m) := by
   327	  apply Subtype.ext
   328	  apply Prod.ext
   329	  · simpa [thetaSectionPairMul] using
   330	      (thetaSectionPair_thetaWindowMul_fst C pi p q a m)
   331	  · simpa [thetaSectionPairMul] using
   332	      (thetaSectionPair_thetaWindowMul_snd C pi p q a m)
   333	
   334	@[simp]
   335	theorem thetaSectionPair_add (n : Nat)
   336	    (a b : ↥(divisorSections k (n • F) ⊤)) :
   337	    thetaSectionPair C pi n (a + b) =
   338	      thetaSectionPair C pi n a + thetaSectionPair C pi n b := by
   339	  simp [thetaSectionPair]
   340	
   341	theorem exists_thetaSectionPair_coordinate_decomposition (g m : Nat)
   342	    (hm : windowS_choice pi hpi g ≤ m) (h : H(1 + m)) :
   343	    ∃ z₀ z₁ : H m,
   344	      thetaSectionPair C pi (1 + m) h =
   345	        thetaSectionPairMul (C := C) pi 1 m
   346	          (thetaSectionPair C pi 1 (thetaCoordinateFstOne (C := C) pi hpi))
   347	          (thetaSectionPair C pi m z₀) +
   348	        thetaSectionPairMul (C := C) pi 1 m
   349	          (thetaSectionPair C pi 1 (thetaCoordinateSndOne (C := C) pi hpi))
   350	          (thetaSectionPair C pi m z₁) := by
   351	  obtain ⟨z₀, z₁, hz⟩ := exists_thetaCoordinate_decomposition
   352	    (C := C) pi hpi g m hm h
   353	  refine ⟨z₀, z₁, ?_⟩
   354	  rw [hz, thetaSectionPair_add,
   355	    thetaSectionPair_thetaWindowMul, thetaSectionPair_thetaWindowMul]
   356	
   357	end CoordinateRecurrence
   358	
   359	end AlgebraicGeometry

     9	
    10	/-!
    11	# Pure high-window multiplication spans
    12	
    13	Write `F = fiberWeilDivisor pi` and `S = windowS_choice pi hpi g`.  The
    14	two-coordinate recurrence gives
    15	
    16	`H^0((m+1)F) = H^0(mF) + u^-1 H^0(mF)`
    17	
    18	for `m >= S`.  Iterating this recurrence shows that every section in
    19	`H^0((q+m)F)` is a sum of products of a section in `H^0(qF)` and a section in
    20	`H^0(mF)`.  In particular, multiplication by the full `S`-window carries the
    21	pure arithmetic progression `S + n*S` onto its successor.
    22	
    23	This is the field-level normal-generation input for eventual closure of the
    24	recursive relation readings under arbitrary pinned-chart coefficients.  It
    25	makes no assertion over the nonreduced carve-chart ring.
    26	-/
    27	
    28	set_option autoImplicit false
    29	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    30	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 8
    31	set_option maxRecDepth 8000
    32	set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
    33	
    34	universe u
    35	
    36	open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace Opposite
    37	
    38	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    39	
    40	open Scheme
    41	
    42	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    43	  Scheme.functionFieldOverModule
    44	
    45	section PureWindowH1
    46	
    47	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    48	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi] [IsDominant pi]
    49	
    50	noncomputable local instance instOverCleftThetaCoordinateMulSpanH1 :
    51	    C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩
    52	
    53	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsIntegral C.left]
    54	  [LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))]

## Why I Stopped

The remaining statement is not merely technical. For every residue field and every high-window multiplication map, one must prove

```text
ker(multiplication) = range(Koszul boundary).
```

Only `range ⊆ ker` and multiplication surjectivity are currently proved. The missing reverse inclusion is precisely a relative Gotzmann/first-syzygy theorem, equivalently the unproved finrank lower bound at [DivSchemeHighWindowKoszul.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/DivSchemeHighWindowKoszul.lean:296).

Choosing the actual global kernel does not bypass this: [DivSchemeHighWindowSyzygy.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/DivSchemeHighWindowSyzygy.lean:254) proves that its fibre-base-change law is equivalent to the desired quotient flatness, so that argument would be circular.

The old Jacobian flattening theorem changes the base to locally closed rank strata and its Quot endpoint is still sorry-backed. The redesign theorem proves flatness only for the `RZ`-linear reading range, not the larger chart ideal. Neither is a drop-in completion.

Therefore representability is not yet fully formalized. The next substantive task is proving that relative first-syzygy rank estimate, or deliberately porting the full flattening-stratification route.

    78	/-- Degree of a natural multiple: `deg (n • D) = n · deg D`. -/
    79	private lemma deg_nsmul (n : ℕ) (D : X.CurveDivisor) :
    80	    CurveDivisor.deg K (n • D) = n * CurveDivisor.deg K D := by
    81	  induction n with
    82	  | zero => rw [zero_nsmul, CurveDivisor.deg_zero, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul]

    85	/-- Degree of a difference: `deg (A − B) = deg A − deg B`. -/
    86	private lemma deg_sub (A B : X.CurveDivisor) :
    87	    CurveDivisor.deg K (A - B) = CurveDivisor.deg K A - CurveDivisor.deg K B := by
    88	  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, CurveDivisor.deg_add, CurveDivisor.deg_neg, sub_eq_add_neg]

    11	# Persistence at every high divisor-scheme window
    12	
    13	The two Grassmannian windows recover an effective degree-`g` divisor `D` on every
    14	field fibre.  The same multiplication argument is not confined to those first two
    15	windows: after replacing `N` by `N + n * S`, the degree budgets only improve.  Thus
    16	the full `S`-window carries `H^0(O(N + n*S - D))` onto the next stage for every `n`.
    17

    19	direct-limit construction.  It does not itself construct the relative high-window
    20	modules over the carve-chart ring.

    46	/-- Multiplication persistence is uniform in the high-window index.  The hypotheses
    47	are exactly the abstract P-fib window pack at `N` and `S`; at `N + n • S` all degree
    48	and normalization inequalities follow from the original ones. -/
    49	theorem mulSpan_divisorSections_highWindow_of_pack
    50	    (g : ℕ) (hO : Sheaf.h0 (Y.moduleKSheaf K) = 1)
    51	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (Y.moduleKSheaf K) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
    52	    (N S : Y.CurveDivisor) (β : ℤ)
    53	    (hvan : ∀ W : Y.CurveDivisor, β ≤ CurveDivisor.deg K W →
    54	      Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (Y.divisorSheaf K W) 1))
    55	    (hNdeg : 2 * (g : ℤ) ≤ CurveDivisor.deg K N)
    56	    (hSdeg : 2 * (g : ℤ) ≤ CurveDivisor.deg K S)
    57	    (hβS : β + 2 * (g : ℤ) ≤ CurveDivisor.deg K S)

events.text: A concrete route is emerging from the window arithmetic. The huge `M` budget is strong enough for a basepoint-free pencil argument: use `1` and `u^{-S}` inside the multiplier window, reduce arbitrary full-window relations to that pencil, and spend one `H¹(A-2S)=0` vanishing to lift coefficients. This would prove the required first Koszul exactness without importing general Gotzmann theory. I’m checking that the existing divisor-section lattice API supports the two pencil lemmas cleanly.

events.text: I’m adding a new, isolated pencil-reduction module. Its theorem is pure finite linear algebra: if two coefficient combinations generate every middle-window element and their two-term kernel is the expected Koszul relation, then the full basis-indexed multiplication kernel is generated by the existing finite Koszul boundary. This removes the high-dimensional syzygy problem and leaves exactly two geometric pencil lemmas.

`B ⊔ (B - div(v)) = A` for spanning and `A ⊓ (A + div(v)) = B` for the pencil kernel. This keeps fibre-coordinate arithmetic separate from the reusable exactness theorem.
